analytics.body: Provider: Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland. Purpose: pseudonymised statistics about how this website is used (e.g. pages viewed, time on site, where visitors come from). Cookies (_ga, _ga_*) with a lifetime of up to 2 years are set. Data may be transferred to the USA (EU-US Data Privacy Framework). Google Signals and advertising features are disabled.
